scenario: HR runs a quarterly anonymous exit-survey aggregation pipeline. Free-text comments from departing employees are summarized, direct PII is redacted, and an internal aggregated report is published to department heads. The report includes thematic bullet points from respondents and a demographic breakdown by team cohort.
info_flow: expanso-text-summarize ingests raw free-text exit survey responses and normalizes them into structured bullet-point summaries per respondent → expanso-pii-redact strips direct PII from each summary (names, emails, phone numbers) → ub2-markdown-report-generator compiles the team-level aggregated report combining per-respondent bullet summaries with the demographic cohort table.
